vo: Every campaign brings shoppers to your store. Almost all of them leave without buying, and without telling you who they were.
Take one of them. She lands from an Instagram ad. No account, no email, no history.
From the very first click, Convertive builds a live profile. Every view, every hesitation. Intent and exit risk, in real time.
At thirty-two seconds, she's about to leave. Convertive ranks every action it could take, and picks the one most likely to work, in forty-one milliseconds.
She sees one offer: ten percent off, today only. She enters her email to claim it, and her anonymous visit becomes a known profile in your email tools.
Forty-seven seconds after she arrived, the order is placed.
Without Convertive, the same visit ends at forty-one seconds. No sale. No email. No way back.
Most tools react hours later. Convertive acts while the shopper is still there.
Live profiles, real-time decisioning, and in-session journeys, on top of the stack you already run.
Convertive. Convert anonymous visitors before they leave.
